failure_summary.description: Added unrelated searches or proximity calls, or repeated an initial search instead of performing only the requested operation.
Skipped a required hotel update, searched instead of filtering a suitable cached result, or omitted active restaurant criteria from the filter.
Mapped a state abbreviation to city and/or failed to save the attraction result.
Parsed and reformatted user-provided date strings rather than passing them unchanged.

patch.reasoning: Most observed errors violate rules that are already explicit, so repeating them would add little. One useful clarification is that a cached base may be broader than the full conversation: a follow-up filter should include every active same-domain criterion that the base does not reflect, not just values mentioned in the latest turn.

edits.target: Apply only the new same-domain filter and save the update under a fresh relevant key.
edits.content: Apply one same-domain filter with every active user constraint for that deliverable that the selected base does not already reflect, including criteria from earlier turns omitted by a broad initial search; save the exact result under a fresh relevant key and do not reapply criteria already reflected in the base.
